AnalysisRunSummary.description: ``GET .../analysis-runs`` row: no plan, steps or dashboard bodies.
AnalysisRunSummary.title: AnalysisRunSummary

ClaimView.description: The claim with its evidence embedded (design 39 read model).
ClaimView.title: ClaimView

DatasetVersion.description: Immutable content snapshot; only ``state`` (and its bookkeeping) advances.
DatasetVersion.title: DatasetVersion

EvidenceData.description: ``GET /evidence/{id}/data``: one object per row, keyed by column name.
EvidenceData.title: EvidenceData

FindingView.description: One ranked RCA factor for the RCA panel (``analytics.explain_change`` finding).
FindingView.title: FindingView

FormatSpec.description: Fixed formatting vocabulary; the frontend never evaluates format strings (design 57).
FormatSpec.title: FormatSpec

Insight.description:
What was observed (a calculation) kept apart from possible explanations (contributions or
associations, never causes). Only VALID insights are shown (PRD-DASH-006).
Insight.title: Insight

NumberView.description: A number segment as shown: the validator's NumberSegment plus the evidence value.
NumberView.title: NumberView

Override.description:
One user correction, re-applied after every (re-)mapping (TASK-SEM-009).

``field`` paths (app.data.overrides): ``mapping.<column>`` (value = concept name, confirms
the column's mapping), ``measures.<name>.default_agg`` / ``measures.<name>.unit``, and
``metrics.<name>.expr`` (value = metric expression; adds or replaces the metric).
Override.title: Override

ReasonCode.description:
Why an analysis is unavailable. Shown to users via ``Unavailability`` and ``unavailable``
dashboard widgets (typed result, not an error: TRD 35 ANALYSIS_UNAVAILABLE).
ReasonCode.title: ReasonCode

TurnEvent.description:
Exported contract (shared/schemas/turn_event.schema.json): one SSE ``data`` payload.

``seq`` equals the SSE ``id`` and ``event.type`` the SSE ``event`` name.
TurnEvent.title: TurnEvent

TurnState.description: design §33. Deviation: any non-terminal state may go to FAILED on a fatal error.
TurnState.title: TurnState

post.description: Enqueues an `audit_verify` job for the caller's workspace; poll GET /jobs/{id}.

Public. Sets the HttpOnly session cookie (a new session id on every login) and returns
the CSRF token. Wrong email and wrong password give the same 401.
Revokes the session server-side and clears the cookie. Requires the CSRF header.

get.description: The current user, workspace and role, plus the CSRF token (for SPA reloads).

Response List Connectors Api V1 Connectors Get

post.description:
Register a PostgreSQL source (one table or one SELECT). The host must be allow-listed
(`APP_CONNECTORS__ALLOWED_HOSTS`); the password is stored encrypted and never returned.

Enqueue a snapshot import; poll GET /jobs/{id}. Its result is the new dataset version,
which then follows the upload pipeline (ingest -> profile -> understand).

schema.title: Response List Datasets Api V1 Datasets Get

post.description:
Upload a CSV/.xlsx file. Side effects: stored raw file; dataset (unless `dataset_id` is
given), version (UPLOADED), ingest job and DatasetUploaded outbox rows in one transaction.

200.description: Idempotency-Key replay or identical content (existing version)

put.description:
Set the domain of the dataset's latest version (always wins; audited); re-maps it and
enqueues a re-plan. Later versions of the dataset keep the override.

schema.title: Response List Versions Api V1 Datasets  Dataset Id  Versions Get

get.description: The version's analysis runs, newest first (state, timestamps, step counts).

schema.title: Response List Analysis Runs Api V1 Datasets  Dataset Id  Versions  Version Id  Analysis Runs Get

get.description:
Which analyses the data supports, and for each that it does not: "Insufficient data" with
the specific missing requirement and what would enable it.
Malformed-row sample: row numbers and reasons only, never row content.
The current semantic model, or the given model ``version`` (every version is kept).

patch.description:
Apply overrides -> a new model version (audited) -> re-plan. 409 if ``base_version`` is
stale; 422 if an override cannot be applied.

get.description:
The stored result rows behind an evidence record (<= 500), for chart and table widgets.
Same permission and scope as the evidence itself; rows hold no SQL, so nothing is redacted.
Liveness only: no auth, no dependency checks.

Readiness: 503 (error envelope, B8) when the database or job queue is down; LLM down is
only `degraded`.
